images.alt: Bangle size guide: 2.4, 2.6 and 2.8 inches with inner diameter in centimetres and how to choose

bodies: Each set of 4 comes in sizes 2.4, 2.6 and 2.8 (inner diameter in inches). Bring your thumb and little finger together and pick the size that just slides over the widest part of your hand. Between two sizes, choose the larger one.
